# Dionisio Developer

> Personal site of Eduardo Dionisio (@dionisiodev), a C++ Software Developer & AI Engineer. Practical C++ (modern language features, ownership, concurrency, performance engineering), applied AI, developer tooling, career guidance, technical reference material, and a small shop of guides and ebooks.

## Blog

- [Technical Articles (Blog)](https://dionisio.dev/en/artigos-tecnicos/): All English technical articles on C++, performance, applied AI and career.
- [RAII in C++ — Ownership as a Type, Not a Convention](https://dionisio.dev/en/artigos-tecnicos/raii/): Deterministic resource management and RAII in modern C++.
- [Move Semantics in C++ — std::move Doesn't Move Anything](https://dionisio.dev/en/artigos-tecnicos/move-semantics/): Rvalue references, value categories, and why the copy you thought you removed still runs.
- [Smart Pointers in C++ — unique_ptr, shared_ptr and weak_ptr](https://dionisio.dev/en/artigos-tecnicos/smart-pointers/): Choosing the right smart pointer and how ownership works.
- [C++ by Version — What Changed from C++98 to C++26](https://dionisio.dev/en/artigos-tecnicos/cpp-versoes-features/): A per-version tour of the C++ language and standard library.
- [C++ in High-Frequency Trading — What Actually Matters for Low Latency](https://dionisio.dev/en/artigos-tecnicos/cpp-hft-low-latency/): Low-latency C++ engineering and performance in HFT systems.
- [RSS feed](https://dionisio.dev/rss.xml): Subscribe to new English articles.

## Reference

- [Reference (Guides)](https://dionisio.dev/en/reference/): Technical reference and learning material — data types, data structures, algorithms and more.
- [C++ Learning Path](https://dionisio.dev/en/reference/trilha-cpp/): A structured roadmap for learning C++ from the ground up.

## Downloads

- [Downloads](https://dionisio.dev/en/downloads/): Free technical wallpapers and checklists. No signup, no email.
- [Data Structures Blueprint wallpaper](https://dionisio.dev/downloads/wallpapers/data-structures-wallpaper.png): 1920x1080 PNG reference for arrays, linked lists, hash tables, stacks, queues, trees and graphs with operation complexities.
- [C++ modernization checklist (EN, Markdown)](https://dionisio.dev/downloads/cpp-modernization-checklist-en.md): A code-review checklist for taking one legacy C++ change to review.

## Mentorship (PT-BR only)

- [Mentoria 1:1](https://dionisio.dev/pt/mentoria/): Mentoria técnica e de carreira 1:1 — diagnóstico, plano de 90 dias e acompanhamento. A partir de R$ 297.
- [Diagnóstico (modelo entregável)](https://dionisio.dev/material/diagnostico-modelo.md): O documento de diagnóstico que o mentorado recebe após a Sessão 1.
